summary: Full backend + frontend regression of the Latin Quarter fork. Backend: created /app/backend/tests/test_latin_rebrand_smoke.py (42 tests) — 41 pass, 1 fail (fixed-fees master truncated to 200 of 272). Verified health, both logins (admin@fundle.ai, marketing@fundle.ai), JWT protection, legacy admin@kazo.com removed, uploads=2 (42,550 sales / 28,537 settlement), sales=42,550, calculations=42,550, settlement=28,537, discrepancies=28,537, recovery cases=5,000, commission rules=155, reports/months includes 2026-06, monthly report + Excel export 200, health-score 200, morning-brief 200 with source=llm, all 8 master endpoints 200 and free of 'kazo' strings. Frontend: logged in as admin and as marketing, walked Login, Overview, Reports, Uploads, Sales Ledger, Calculations, Reconciliation, Discrepancies, Recovery, AI Insights, Masters (all 8 tabs) — every page rendered real data with ZERO console errors and ZERO occurrences of 'kazo/KAZO' in the rendered DOM. Header shows 'Latin Quarter · MARKETPLACE OS' with the 'Powered by Fundle' badge on both login and sidebar. Overview KPIs match expectation (NSV Rs 4,43,93,042.36 / 42,550 orders / 28,537 discrepancies / recoverable Rs 2,10,85,536.55). Morning Brief generated a real LLM narrative. Reconciliation 0-matched / all-variance treated as known/expected per request.

minor.issue: Hard-caps results with .to_list(200) while the collection holds 272 slabs — 72 fixed-fee slabs are invisible in API and in the Masters > FIXED FEE tab (UI shows 200 rows). Raise/remove the cap or paginate.

Return 200 but with 0 rows (collections empty for Latin Quarter). Meanwhile loaded calculations carry non-zero gt_charge values, so the GT / Return-Fee masters are not the source of the displayed numbers.

ui_bugs.issue: REBRAND MISS: downloaded file is named 'KAZO_Myntra_Report_2026-06.xlsx' (Reports.jsx line 40). User-visible KAZO branding.

No pagination UI at all — each page fetches a fixed limit:500 and renders 500 rows with no Next/Load-more control, so only 500 of 42,550 sales / 42,550 calculations / 28,537 discrepancies / 5,000 recovery cases are ever reachable.
Hero stat chip says 'COMMISSION ENGINE 173 rules' but the loaded Latin Quarter master has 155 rules (Masters page shows '155 RULES'). Hardcoded/stale number.

SKU column renders raw Excel text-guard artifacts such as "'132910403844774044203" (leading apostrophe, and value looks like a settlement id, not an SKU) whereas Sales Ledger shows clean SKUs like LTQRDRSS81908972.
marketing@fundle.ai (role viewer) sees Masters/Uploads with admin-only Add Rule / Upload (replace) buttons; those calls are require_admin and will 403. Hide or disable for non-admins.

issues: Tabs render an empty table body with no empty-state message — looks like a broken page rather than 'no rules configured'

action_items: Rename the Reports Excel download to Latin Quarter branding (Reports.jsx line 40 currently 'KAZO_Myntra_Report_...'). Also rebrand the masters export filename 'kazo-commission-masters-*.xlsx' (masters.py:468) and, optionally, the localStorage keys kazo_token / kazo_user (AuthContext.jsx, lib/api.js).
Add pagination (or infinite scroll) to Sales Ledger, Calculations, Discrepancies and Recovery — currently hard-capped at 500 rows client-side.
Remove the .to_list(200) cap on GET /api/masters/fixed-fees (272 rows exist).
Fix the hardcoded '173 rules' stat on the Login hero (actual 155).
Decide/seed the GT (Logistics) and Return Fee masters for Latin Quarter — they are empty, so 'Run Calculations' from the UI would drop the GT / return-fee components that latin_loader wrote directly.
Clean the leading-apostrophe / wrong-field SKU values surfaced on Discrepancies and Recovery.
critical_code_review_comments: latin_loader.py writes the calculations collection directly from raw Myntra columns (commission_pct=null, fixed_fee=0.0, gt_charge taken from the file) — the 155-rule commission engine is NOT what produced the currently displayed numbers. Any admin clicking 'Run Calculations' on the Calculations page will recompute through the rule engine and, with gt_charges/return_fees empty, will replace today's KPIs with unmapped/zero components. Guard or reconcile before shipping.
Master list endpoints use fixed .to_list(N) caps (fixed-fees 200, return-fees 200, subcat-levels 500) with no total/paging — silently truncates data.
List endpoints expose limit/skip but no frontend page uses skip, so the API pagination contract is untested/unused in the product.
